_comment: HIDDEN acceptance spec for Track P (storefront). NOT shown to the harness. The sandbox runner + scorer use it. Journeys are verified by a Playwright-driven checker using role/name heuristics (the app's exact selectors/routes are the harness's choice); REST checks are best-effort against discovered endpoints; visual anchors drive the vision judge; capability_descriptors are the VERTEX reference distribution.

checks.desc: home page renders a brand header with category navigation (Damen/Herren/Kinder or Women/Men/Kids)
a cart affordance is present in the header
a category/listing page shows a product grid with multiple products
at least one working filter or sort control changes the listing
clicking a product opens a detail page with an image, a price, and a size/variant selector
an add-to-cart control is present and enabled after selecting a size
checks.name_re: (add to cart|in den warenkorb|add to bag)

checks.desc: after add-to-cart, the cart shows the line item with name, price, size/color and quantity
quantity can be changed and an item can be removed; totals update
order summary shows subtotal, delivery, and total that are arithmetically consistent (integer cents)
a checkout flow collects the minimum needed info and reaches a payment step
completes a Stripe TEST-mode payment with a test card (4242 4242 4242 4242) and reaches an order confirmation
an order confirmation / success page is shown after payment

rest_contracts.desc: an endpoint returns a list of products as JSON
an endpoint adds an item to a cart and returns the updated cart/total
an endpoint creates an order / payment intent in test mode

pwa.desc: a web app manifest is linked and valid (name, icons, start_url, display)
a service worker registers and caches an offline shell
layout is usable at 390px (mobile) and 1280px (desktop) without overflow

a11y.desc: primary controls are keyboard-reachable and have accessible names

robustness.desc: viewing an empty cart does not error
an invalid/declined test card is handled gracefully (no 500)
an unknown route returns a 404 page, not a stack trace

rubric: sticky promo bar + brand header layout
centered logo with left category links and right account/wishlist/cart icons
card: image, brand bold, name, price, wishlist heart
left thumbnail rail + large product image

capability_descriptors: home page with brand header, category navigation, search and cart
category/listing page with a responsive product grid
working filter and/or sort over the product listing
product detail page with image gallery, price and size/variant selection
add to cart from the product detail page
cart page with editable quantities, item removal and correct totals
checkout flow collecting shipping/contact and reaching payment
Stripe test-mode payment with a test card
order confirmation page after successful payment
installable PWA with a service worker and offline shell
accessible, responsive layout for mobile and desktop
automated end-to-end and unit tests for the core flows
documented build/serve command and CI manifest
architecture_anchors: clear separation between backend API and frontend UI
data models for product, variant, cart, order
tests colocated or in a dedicated test tree
configuration and secrets read from the environment
